## Purpose

The symposium will bring our community together, spark interdisciplinary dialogue, and highlight software and modelling tools that may be useful across multiple disciplines.

## Who Can Attend

Academic staff, research staff, professional staff, postdoctoral researchers, and postgraduate students are welcome. 

Presentations should highlight research that has benefited from modelling or software tools and may inspire or assist people in other disciplines.

## Confirmed Invited Speakers

- **Tulasi Parashar**, School of Chemical and Physical Sciences
- **Stephen Skalicky**, School of Linguistics and Applied Language Studies
- **Marcus Frean**, School of Engineering and Computer Science
- **Alanna Alevropoulos-Borrill**, Antarctic Research Centre
- **Konstantina Vasileva**, Research Office
- **David Roberts**, Digital Solutions

## Registration and Presentations

Please complete the online registration form by **30 October 2026**. 

If you would like to give an oral presentation, submit your talk title and abstract by **30 October 2026**. This deadline applies only to presentation expressions of interest. We will contact prospective presenters after submissions have been reviewed.
